text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин and I have come to
watch a
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Soba, udon, steak, soft serve ice
cream, carrot
donuts—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
No. Earlier in class, we were discussing
racecourse
food.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
This scent of excessively seasoned junk
food... I'd
never noticed it before, but
now...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Its inescapable allure is drawing me in!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Do you want to take a look?

text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I cannot deny the curiosity born
from
everyone's discussion of these
flavors.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
That's why there is something for which I
must
request your cooperation.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I would disgrace the Mejiro family name
if I am
left completely ignorant of the
foods being
offered here. So, would you
come have a taste
with me?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
An interesting proposition, but
everything on
offer sounds rather
unhealthy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's! Now, I will take half—no! Just
a bite.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The strong flavor comes as a surprise
initially,
but... Yes, I can see why this is a
popular topic of
conversation.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I seldom get to experience this sort of
flavor at
home or at the academy, but
just one bite is
enough to tell me it lacks
nutritional balance.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It's delicious, but... you could call it a
natural
enemy to those on a diet. Yes, a
taboo flavor! I
must be careful not to
overindulge.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Y-yes... I can see why this food is such a
popular
topic of conversation.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I've eaten more than I anticipated, which
has
resulted in quite a painful situation.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I-it's not my fault! I was entranced by the

delicious aroma of junk food!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Urk... I understand. If those are your
directions,
then I will abide by them.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
E-even so, I would like to have the
opportunity
someday! After all, it is a
Mejiro's duty to expand
her horizons!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Мэдзиро МакКуин shivers as we depart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин seems to have
overcome this
temptation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин ate so much that she
can't seem
to focus on watching the
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
